summary: Scorpio Tankers filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing agreements to sell three product tankers and purchase four newbuildings. The sales comprise the 2014-built MR STI Dama for $37.5M, the 2014-built LR2 STI Elysees for $70.0M, and the 2015-built LR2 STI Veneto for $73.0M, expected to close before end-2026. Newbuildings comprise two LR2s at Jiangsu Hantong for $72.8M each (deliveries Oct-Nov 2029) and two VLCCs at Hengli Dalian for $135.0M each (deliveries Sep-Oct 2028). No board recommendation or advisor named; no premium applies.
